query:
SELECT equipamentoTag, ROUND(SUM(CAST(custo AS DECIMAL(14,2))), 2) as total
FROM item_despesa_importado
WHERE periodoCustoId = 60001 AND equipamentoTag LIKE '%DRAGA%'
GROUP BY equipamentoTag
